text: GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOALLLL! CITY STRIKE FIRST! After Hojlund’s needless tug on Rodri, Haaland hovers over the spot-kick in front of the Stretford End.
GOOOOOOOOOOOOALLLLLLL! 2-0 CITY! Guardiola’s visitors tear United to pieces at Old Trafford.
Haaland's goal was the first penalty scored by City at Old Trafford in the Premier League, as well as their first awarded in a fixture there in the competition.
GOOOOOOOOOOOOALLLLLL! 3-0 TO CITY AND GAME OVER! Grealish takes an age to draw Dalot out before offloading to Rodri, who marauds forward before his left-footed strike is parried away by Onana.
WHAT A SAVE! Ederson keeps his side's lead intact on the stroke of half-time with a fantastic stop.
WIDE! Walker completely switches off as Rashford speeds in behind to receive a diagonal pass from Eriksen.

text: SAVE! A first City corner of the game comes on the left-hand side after Grealish looks to progress with a gliding run.
WIDE! Delightful football has United scrambling all over the place.
ANOTHER GREAT STOP! Silva ghosts down the left flank to latch onto Grealish's chipped pass, before lofting an inviting delivery towards the far post.
Foden nods a first-time header towards the top-left corner, where Onana parries away an unconvincing save.
Down the other end, Dalot's near-post cross is calmly dealt with by Stones.
Argentina's World Cup winner sets his sights on the top-left corner but miscues a left-footed effort well wide to the left of goal.
